75949-terror-keep.title: Terror Keep
75949-terror-keep.creator: Edgar Wallace
75949-terror-keep.description: A book by Edgar Wallace. Once, as a great concession, old Jack gave him a book to read, and the Governor read and gasped. It was entitled “Method of robbing a bank vault when only two guards are employed.” The Governor, who had been a soldier, read and read, stopping now and then to rub his head; for this document, written in the neat, legible hand of John Flack, was curiously reminiscent of a divisional order for attack.

arxiv-2104-10076.title: MixDefense: A Defense-in-Depth Framework for Adversarial Example Detection Based on Statistical and Semantic Analysis
arxiv-2104-10076.creator: Yijun Yang, Ruiyuan Gao, Yu Li, Qiuxia Lai, Qiang Xu*
arxiv-2104-10076.description: Abstract Machine learning with deep neural networks (DNNs) has become one of the foundation techniques in many safety-critical systems, such as autonomous vehicles and medical diagnosis systems. DNN-based systems, however, are known to be vulnerable to adversarial examples (AEs) that are maliciously perturbed variants of legitimate inputs.

arxiv-2301-04575.title: Wilson lines construction of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} toroidal conformal blocks
arxiv-2301-04575.creator: Vladimir Belavin, Pietro Oreglia, J. Ramos Cabezas
arxiv-2301-04575.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vladimir Belavin, Pietro Oreglia, J. Ramos Cabezas. We study 𝒲 3 \mathcal{W}_{3} toroidal conformal blocks for degenerate primary fields in AdS/CFT context. In the large central charge limit 𝒲 3 \mathcal{W}_{3} algebra reduces to 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} algebra and 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} blocks are defined as contributions to 𝒲 3 \mathcal{W}_{3} blocks coming from the generators of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} subalgebra.

arxiv-2309-12002.title: Lateral Solid Phase Epitaxy of Yttrium Iron Garnet
arxiv-2309-12002.creator: Sebastian Sailler, Darius Pohl, Heike Schlörb, Bernd Rellinghaus, Andy Thomas, Sebastian T. B. Goennenwein, Michaela Lammel
arxiv-2309-12002.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sebastian Sailler, Darius Pohl, Heike Schlörb, Bernd Rellinghaus, Andy Thomas, Sebastian T. B. Goennenwein, Michaela Lammel. Solid phase epitaxy is a crystallization technique used to produce high quality thin films. Lateral solid phase epitaxy furthermore enables the realization of non-planar structures, which are interesting, e.g., in the field of spintronics. Here, we demonstrate lateral solid phase epitaxy of yttrium iron garnet over an artificial edge, such that the crystallization direction is perpendicular to the initial seed.

arxiv-2511-18755.title: Splatonic : Architectural Support for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM via Sparse Processing
arxiv-2511-18755.creator: Xiaotong Huang 1,† , He Zhu 1,† , Tianrui Ma 3 , Yuxiang Xiong 1 , Fangxin Liu 1 Zhezhi He 1 , Yiming Gan 3 , Zihan Liu 1, 2, * , Jingwen Leng 1, 2 , Yu Feng 1, 2, * , Minyi Guo 1, 2
arxiv-2511-18755.description: Abstract 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising direction for SLAM due to its high-fidelity reconstruction and rapid convergence. However, 3DGS-SLAM algorithms remain impractical for mobile platforms due to their high computational cost, especially for their tracking process. This work introduces Splatonic , a sparse and efficient real-time 3DGS-SLAM algorithm-hardware co-design for resource-constrained devices.

arxiv-2512-13238.title: Ego-EXTRA: video-language Egocentric Dataset for EXpert-TRAinee assistance
arxiv-2512-13238.creator: Francesco Ragusa, Michele Mazzamuto, Rosario Forte, Irene D’Ambra, James Fort, Jakob Engel, Antonino Furnari, Giovanni Maria Farinella
arxiv-2512-13238.description: Abstract We present Ego-EXTRA, a video-language Egocentric Dataset for EXpert-TRAinee assistance. Ego-EXTRA features 50 50 hours of unscripted egocentric videos of subjects performing procedural activities (the trainees) while guided by real-world experts who provide guidance and answer specific questions using natural language.

pmc-10644355.title: Small-Molecule Antibiotic Drug Development: Need and Challenges
pmc-10644355.creator: Megan Bergkessel, Barbara Forte, Ian H. Gilbert
pmc-10644355.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The need for new antibiotics is urgent. Antimicrobial resistance is rising, although currently, many more people die from drug-sensitive bacterial infections. The continued evolution of drug resistance is inevitable, fueled by pathogen population size and exposure to antibiotics. Additionally, opportunistic pathogens will always pose a threat to vulnerable patients whose immune systems cannot efficiently fight them even if they are sensitive to available antibiotics, according to clinical microbiology tests.

pmc-11517449.title: Digital services as alternative for in-person visits among clients with long-term illnesses
pmc-11517449.creator: E Kainiemi, L Virtanen, A-M Aalto, T Heponiemi
pmc-11517449.description: BackgroundFor individuals managing long-term illnesses and often requiring complex care across health and social care sectors, the transition to digital platforms holds considerable potential to facilitate management of one’s health. This study examined factors among people with long-term illnesses associated with their perception that digital services had replaced in-person visits in health and social care.

pmc-11544809.title: Environmental Contaminants in Fish Products: Food Safety Issues and Remediation Strategies
pmc-11544809.creator: Pierina Visciano
pmc-11544809.description: The intentional or accidental presence of environmental contaminants, such as persistent organic pollutants, metals, and microplastics, can harm the aquatic ecosystem and their living organisms, as well as consumers of seafood. This study provides an overview of marine pollution caused by various chemicals and their toxicity to both the environment and humans.

pmc-11612195.title: An effective and open source interactive 3D medical image segmentation solution
pmc-11612195.creator: Yi Gao, Xiaohui Chen, Qinzhu Yang, Andras Lasso, Ivan Kolesov, Steve Pieper, Ron Kikinis, Allen Tannenbaum, Liangjia Zhu
pmc-11612195.description: 3D medical image segmentation is a key step in numerous clinical applications. Even though many automatic segmentation solutions have been proposed, it is arguably that medical image segmentation is more of a preference than a reference as inter- and intra-variability are widely observed in final segmentation output.

pmc-11674205.title: Effects of Different Crystallization Protocols on Marginal Gap of Lithium Disilicate Single Crowns: SEM Analysis
pmc-11674205.creator: Alon Shadur, Joseph Nissan, Diva Lugassy, Ariana Umansky, Eran Zenziper, Gil Ben-Izhack, Gabriele Cervino
pmc-11674205.description: Objective: In everyday dentistry, lithium disilicate is a valid option for single-fix partial dentures, and this material crystallization process is available with two protocols: long and short. This study’s aim was to assess the effects of these two different crystallization protocols, long and short, on the marginal gap of lithium disilicate single crowns.

pmc-11692951.title: MALNUTRITION RISK AMONG OLDER AMERICANS ACT (OAA) NUTRITION PROGRAM PARTICIPANTS IN 2022 AND 2023

pmc-11935283.title: Resetting the Drift of Oxygen Vacancies in Ultrathin HZO Ferroelectric Memories by Electrical Pulse Engineering
pmc-11935283.creator: Atif Jan, Stephanie A Fraser, Taehwan Moon, Yun Seong Lee, Hagyoul Bae, Hyun Jae Lee, Duk‐Hyun Choe, Maximilian T Becker, Judith L MacManus‐Driscoll, Jinseong Heo, Giuliana Di Martino
pmc-11935283.description: Ferroelectric HfO2‐based films incorporated in nonvolatile memory devices offer a low‐energy, high‐speed alternative to conventional memory systems. Oxygen vacancies have been rigorously cited in literature to be pivotal in stabilizing the polar noncentrosymmetric phase responsible for ferroelectricity in HfO2‐based films.

pmc-12653854.title: Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic Modeling of Clobazam and Stiripentol Co-Therapy in Dravet Syndrome
pmc-12653854.creator: Bassma Eltanameli, Sulafa Al Sahlawi, Rodrigo Cristofoletti, Youssef Daali
pmc-12653854.description: Background: Dravet syndrome, a severe early-onset epileptic encephalopathy, is treated with multiple antiepileptic drugs such as clobazam (CLB) and stiripentol (STP), increasing the risk of drug–drug interactions (DDIs). Given the limited pediatric pharmacokinetic data, this study developed physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models for CLB and STP to optimize dosing and assess DDI risk across pediatric age groups.

pmc-13450957.title: High Prevalence of Secondary Hyperparathyroidism Before Kidney Transplantation in Brazil
pmc-13450957.creator: Lorena C. Mainardes, Eduardo J. Duque, Elias David-Neto, Vanda Jorgetti, Thomas L. Nickolas, Rosilene M. Elias, Rosa M.A. Moysés
pmc-13450957.description: d with declining kidney function, including CKD-mineral and bone disorder. However, in patients with severe preexisting secondary hyperparathyroidism (HPT), restoration of kidney function is often insufficient to fully reverse these abnormalities. Consequently, persistent HPT can develop following KTX. Persistent HPT has been associated with adverse clinical outcomes, including graft dysfunction, bone loss, increased fracture risk, and cardiovascular complications.
